rule_zh: 任何 claim 必须归类到三级之一；描述可复算，预测须注明模型与种子，规范须标注'待审定'。禁止跨级声称（预测当描述、规范当事实）。
rule_en: Every claim maps to one of three levels; descriptions recomputable, predictions name their model and seed, norms marked pending approval.
